groups.label: What exists already — one paragraph, not a system

items.t: The L6 definition lives as one paragraph plus a branches bullet list, not its own SSOT file: `📐 ssot_01_story_spine_comparative_tree.md:108-110` (the definition) and `:161-163` (the branches). Every sibling system — plot 04, setting 03, texture, genre — has its own file, a twelve-layer slice, a card/contract instrument, and an OXO bench instance; theme has none of that (DISTILL.md §1, §6.2).

The shelf is thin by its own admission: "one Bloom's one-sheet, the INSPIRATION shelf, Tomashevsky theme & motif, Greimas isotopy" (`BOLO.md:102`). Confirmed directly by the distill: no `BVX.0289` (Weiland) file exists anywhere in `_0.1_BVX_LEARN/KNOWLEDGE_AREAS/` despite being named the shelf's dedicated theme-craft holding twice (`📐 ssot_01_story_spine_comparative_tree.md:110,183`; DISTILL.md §3, §6.1).

groups.label: What the record already says — OXO's argument, scattered not consolidated

items.t: The premise line, the ending matrix, the IC's demonstrated premise, and Tori's thesis lines all exist already — `oxo-storyform.md`, `victoria-midnight.md`, `anna-colson-conway.md`, `oxo-telling-profile.md` — none of it consolidated under a theme heading (DISTILL.md §4).

Theme has no instrument analog: plot has the PLOT CARD, setting the SCENE CARD, texture the TELLING PROFILE, genre the GENRE CARD/CONTRACT — theme has no THEME CARD, no slice, no bench table. This is the literal gap BOLO 80 exists to close (DISTILL.md §1.5, §6.2).
